title: Flat featureless arena. The combat scenario fixtures in tools/harness/scenarios/ load this, and viewpoint VP12 anchors on it.
note: Named states double as the viewpoint anchors in tools/harness/viewpoints.json: shoot.mjs calls loadState(viewpoint.anchor) before posing the camera, so every anchor id MUST be a loadable state or the viewpoint is unshootable and the metric it feeds scores 0, fail-closed (HARNESS.md §6).

loadout._note: The RI-CMB07 exemplar build: Endurance 20 -> 120 stamina (RI-CMB03 §A), 620 max HP, a straight sword (RI-CMB02's reference class, the one Ps=25 f@60 is pinned to), a Marsh-oak medium shield (stability 0.62 / absorption 0.94 — the shield RI-CMB03 §C's worked guard-break example uses), and 24% equip load, which is LIGHT.
